source_method: Official source YAML at the pinned release tag; layout IDs copied from each circuit file; event hints derived only from explicit year annotations in YAML comments. Exact race-level links, when present, were read from pinned F1DB race.yml files and matched to canonical circuit and layout IDs.
limitations: The source YAML comments are documentation hints, not race-specific proof. Confirm each event using the matching season/race race.yml circuitId and circuitLayoutId before asserting the exact historical configuration.
A blank layout year comment does not prove that every event used that layout; no fallback is inferred.
The imported Grid Atlas read model does not yet store F1DB layout identities; this is a research-only crosswalk, not a database migration or public page change.
Corner names, numbering and diagram coordinates are NOT verified by F1DB layout identifiers or SVGs. Never attach corner annotations to a historical layout without independent evidence.
F1DB circuit ID may differ from Grid Atlas editorial slug. Do not change URL slugs or overwrite imported identities based on a naming similarity.
No independent editorial approval or image rights clearance is claimed.
An exact race.yml match verifies a race-specific circuit layout, not the historical narrative, corner naming or media rights.
